description: This file contains implementation for Wi-Fi radio and access point management functions, including adding/removing VAP interfaces, generating interface names, applying MAC addresses, and handling BSSIDs, primarily for hardware abstraction and driver interaction in a Wi-Fi management context.

methods.name: int s_applyMac(T_SSID * pSSID,int ifIndex,char * ifName)
methods.description: Applies the MAC address stored in pSSID to the specified interface name using the hardware abstraction layer.

methods.name: int wifiGen_vap_setBssid(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Sets the BSSID for a given access point by applying its SSID's MAC address.

methods.name: swl_str_copy
methods.description: Copies a string into a destination buffer with size limit.

methods.name: swl_str_isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a string is empty.

methods.name: swl_str_catFormat
methods.description: Concatenates formatted string to an existing string buffer.

methods.name: bool s_getNewVapIfaceName(T_Radio * pRad,T_SSID * pSSID,int if_count,char * ifName,size_t ifNameSize)
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a new, unique VAP interface name, with fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: bool s_updateVapIfaceName(T_Radio * pRad,T_AccessPoint * pAP,const char * vapIfName)
methods.description: Updates the interface alias of an access point with a new vapIfName.

methods.name: int wifiGen_rad_addvapif(T_Radio * pRad,char * ifname,int ifnameSize)
methods.description: Adds a VAP interface to a radio, creates the interface, and updates internal data.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wifiGen_rad_addVap(T_Radio * pRad,T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: High-level function to add a virtual access point (VAP) to a radio and initialize it.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne s_createAp(T_Radio * pRad,T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Creates an access point on a radio, initializing the VAP and its configurations.

methods.name: int s_apIfIndex(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Calculates the interface index for a given Access Point.

methods.name: uint32_t s_apMacIndex(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Calculates the MAC index for a given Access Point.

methods.name: void s_updateAllMacs(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Updates all MAC addresses of endpoints and VAPs associated with a radio, applying shifted or generated MAC addresses.

methods.name: void s_applyAllMacs(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Reapplies MAC addresses to all interfaces of a radio, necessary after MAC shifts for consistency.

methods.name: void s_checkAndProcessMbssBMacChange(T_Radio * pRad,uint32_t apMacIndex)
methods.description: Checks for changes in the base MAC address of an MBSS and propagates updates if needed.

methods.name: int wifiGen_rad_addVapExt(T_Radio * pRad,T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Extended function to add a VAP interface with hardware-specific support and MAC address assignment.

methods.name: int wifiGen_rad_delvapif(T_Radio * pRad,char * vapName)
methods.description: Removes a VAP interface by name.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wifiGen_rad_generateEpIfName(T_Radio * pRad,uint32_t ifaceShift _UNUSED,char * ifName,size_t ifNameSize)
methods.description: Generates interface name for an endpoint, defaulting to the primary radio name.

methods.name: bool s_getNewEpIfaceName(T_Radio * pRad,T_SSID * pSSID,int if_count,char * ifName,size_t ifNameSize)
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a new interface name for an endpoint, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: int wifiGen_rad_addEndpointIf(T_Radio * pRad,char * buf,int bufsize)
methods.description: Adds an endpoint interface on a radio, configuring its MAC and creating the interface.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wifiGen_rad_delendpointif(T_Radio * pRad _UNUSED,char * endpoint)
methods.description: Deletes an endpoint interface by its name.

methods.name: int wifiGen_vap_bssid(T_Radio * pRad,T_AccessPoint * pAP,unsigned char * buf,int bufsize,int set)
methods.description: Gets or sets the BSSID for a VAP, converting between string and binary form as needed.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wifiGen_rad_generateVapIfName(T_Radio * pRad,uint32_t ifaceShift,char * ifName,size_t ifNameSize)
methods.description: unavailable
